comparison.objective: Scrub an IV connector hub for 15 seconds before attaching a flush syringe.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained compliant wiping contact followed by connector attachment.
comparison.success_condition: Specified face coverage, orientation, rubbing speed, accumulated scrub time, and subsequent syringe attachment are required.
comparison.reason: Surface scrubbing and syringe mating do not exercise dual-blade entry around a contact or release-and-pull sequencing.
